const base=$('Prepare Nebius Planner Decision').first().json;const r=$input.first()?.json??{};let parsed=null;const c=r.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;try{parsed=typeof c==='string'?JSON.parse(c.replace(/^```json\s*|\s*```$/g,'')):c}catch{}const allowed=new Set(['RUN','WAIT','REUSE','NOT_APPLICABLE','NOT_REQUESTED']);const decisions=new Map((Array.isArray(parsed?.decisions)?parsed.decisions:[]).map(d=>[String(d.task_key),d]));const tasks=base.candidate_tasks.map(t=>{const d=decisions.get(t.task_key)??{};let choice=allowed.has(String(d.plan_decision))?String(d.plan_decision):t.plan_decision;if(t.locked)choice=t.plan_decision;return {...t,plan_decision:choice,planner_priority:Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Math.round(Number(d.priority)||50))),planner_reason:String(t.locked?'Deterministic gate controller locked this task.':(d.reason??(c?'Planner returned no valid bounded decision; deterministic default retained.':'Nebius planner was unavailable; deterministic safe plan retained.'))).slice(0,1000)};});const viable=new Set(tasks.filter(t=>['RUN','WAIT','REUSE'].includes(t.plan_decision)).map(t=>t.task_key));for(const t of tasks){if(['RUN','REUSE'].includes(t.plan_decision)&&t.dependency_keys.some(d=>!viable.has(d))){t.plan_decision='WAIT';t.planner_reason='A dependency is not runnable; this task is held for Supervisor replan.';}}const plannerQuestions=Array.isArray(parsed?.planner_questions)?parsed.planner_questions.map(String).slice(0,5):[];return [{json:{...base,schema_version:'bp-staged-task-plan-v2',tasks,planner_questions:plannerQuestions,route_reason:String(parsed?.route_reason??(c?'NEBIUS_BOUNDED_PLAN_VALIDATED':'DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK')).slice(0,1000),planner_mode:c?'NEBIUS_BOUNDED':'DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK',model:r.model??null,request:undefined}}];
